widgets_values:
## Preserve clothing and pose

Create one image of this person as the sole subject in the scene described below; Preserve her recognizable identity from the reference image, including her face, hair, skin tone, and defining features, while generating a new single coherent scene; Do not reproduce the reference image, its multiple views, panels, borders, crop, or layout; Ensure that only one reference person appears. 

*******************

## Preserve identity only

Create one image of this person as the sole subject in the scene described below; Preserve her recognizable identity from the reference image, including her face, hair, skin tone, and defining features, excluding clothing and pose, while generating a new single coherent scene; Do not reproduce the reference image, its multiple views, panels, borders, crop, or layout; Ensure that only one reference person appears. 


*******************

## 2×2 storyboard example
（Include some natural language editing prompts within the main prompt to provide guidance！）

Render exactly one 2x2 storyboard grid with four equal panels; use the reference only for the woman's identity; show the same woman in all four panels, with no other people; follow the scene description for everything else.

nodes.title: Model and Usage Guide
widgets_values:
# Krea 2 Reference Image Editing

## Single Reference Image

- A: Reference image for the character's identity.

## Dual Reference Image

- A: Scene reference image.
- B: Character identity reference image.

The exported workflow records the original local input filenames, but the images are not bundled in the JSON. If ComfyUI reports a missing image, select a scene image and a person reference in the two Load Image nodes before running the workflow.

## How to use

1. Edit「Krea2 Prompt」,If you have complex requirements, please enter custom natural language prompts in the 「Krea2 Prompt」field.
2. Choose a style moodboard in the「Krea Moodboard Visual Browser」.
3. Edit「Edit Prompt」.
4. Set the aspect ratio and target megapixels, then enable or bypass LoRAs as needed.
5. Confirm that both reference images are loaded, then queue the workflow.

The 2×2 storyboard example asks for four equal panels that tell one continuous story; results can vary with the model, reference images, and settings.

## Before running

- Krea 2 Turbo diffusion model, Qwen3-VL text encoder, and Qwen Image VAE.
- The LoRA weights referenced by the workflow, including the identity-edit LoRA.
- ComfyUI-Krea2-Harness, a moodboard package that provides Krea Moodboard Visual Browser, and an extension that provides Krea2 Edit nodes.

If a loader shows a missing model, select a compatible file installed on your machine.
